Create ONE isolated red and ivory compact jet aircraft flown by Zhanzhan, premium 2.5D toy illustration. Camera is high above and slightly behind (70 degrees downward), aircraft longitudinal axis strictly vertical. Nose points to TOP of image (screen NORTH), twin exhausts and tail at BOTTOM. Show actual rear/top geometry, NOT an upside-down front-view picture. Swept short wings, ivory center fuselage stripe, polished red wing panels, graphite engine nacelles, subtle metal seams, ivory/silver edges, short paired tail fins, tiny navigation lights without glow. Broad enough cockpit to clearly see the red dragon seated INSIDE and operating the controls, not standing on a plane: recognizable black horns, red head, small white cheek visible as his head glances 20 degrees to the side while body faces forward/up, white gloved hands on flight stick, compact folded wings. Preserve mascot identity, never human. Small LGD badges accurately placed on visible upper wing panels. Clear silhouette readable at 72x80px; avoid microdetail clutter. Aircraft fills 88 percent of a nearly square canvas with equal transparent margins, entire wings and tail visible, centered. Clean soft studio highlights. True RGBA transparency outside aircraft, no sky/background/floor/podium/cast shadow/checkerboard. No fire or long exhaust trails, no text except badge, no labels, no framing, no extra planes, no watermark.
